title: TRENCHCAM — BLOCK 17
summary: Clear a five-storey apartment block with destructible furniture, chipped walls and close-quarters firefights.
description: A realistic first-person shooter seen through a simulated chest-mounted bodycam: fisheye lens, rolling shutter, sensor noise, auto exposure and video compression. On BLOCK 17 you clear a five-storey building held by 22 defenders. Gunfire alarms a floor: one defender investigates while a partner covers, others watch doorways, and pressured defenders retreat. Carry two primary weapons, with authored first-person hands and weapon animations. The updated build adds relief materials, 125 breakable objects, wall and tile chips, material-specific dust and sparks, visible tracers and blood marks. Graphics preparation, reusable grenade and debris visuals, and reduced animation and effect updates address first-use stalls and frame-time spikes. Also includes a trench-line map with team rounds. Built with Three.js WebGPU, Rapier physics, a navmesh and procedural audio.
